'''Mingfang''' is an NPC located in {{Location|Hongzhen}}.

==Location==
Mingfang can be found standing near the pond at the northern border of Hongzhen.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Mingfang:''' Are you guys interested in Mt. Firmament tea?
:'''Mingfang:''' I heard it took seven steps to make tea outside this mountain: preparing teaware, warming teaware, putting in the tea, brewing the tea, discarding the first batch, pouring the tea, and then serving the tea.
:'''Mingfang:''' It's not much different from our local tradition, though we're a little more particular.
:'''Mingfang:''' Just on warming the teaware alone, we don't use boiled water but a scoop of the Sagaci Springs water, heating it with the spring's natural heat.
:'''Mingfang:''' The teaware would get an earthy aroma from the heat, so when you pour the tea, your nostrils are greeted with a scent as if the leaves were freshly plucked from the snow.
:'''Mingfang:''' Here, I just made it with the premium Firmament snow tea leaves. Try it.
{{Dialogue End}}
